black truffle.note: CREA Centro di ricerca Alimenti e Nutrizione, December 2019. Source available carbohydrate 0.7 + total fibre 8.4 = total carbohydrate 9.1. Source energy 48 kcal retained; older guides give 31 kcal using a different energy convention.

glucose.note: Manufacturer 20 g serving: 70 kcal and 18 g carbohydrate; scaled by five. Protein/fat/fibre absent by pure-carbohydrate composition assumption, not separately measured on label. Diary glucose grams assumed powder, not glucose solution.

pepino fruit.note: Vega-Galvez et al., Changes of quality characteristics of pepino fruit during convective drying, Table 1. Divide dry-basis quantities by 1+11.78 to obtain fresh basis. Total carbohydrate by difference. Crude fibre is only a lower-bound proxy for total dietary fibre. Energy derived with 4 kcal/g protein and non-fibre carbs, 9 fat, 2 fibre; not measured energy.

crab cream.note: Chinese 膏蟹 indicates roe-bearing crab. Cooked edible crab meat proxy; proportion of roe/shell unknown.

poria cocos.note: Rehydrated Poria estimate; dry composition comes from a patent table and 5-fold water uptake is assumed.

chinese forest frog.note: Hasma oviduct tissue, not frog meat. Dry research composition diluted by assumed 20-fold rehydration.

peach gum.note: Published five-portion dessert nutrition scaled to assumed final yield 1660 g. Yield assumptions: listed water 1500 g, longan 40 g, peach gum 50 g, sugar 60 g; twenty pitted dates assumed 100 g and tablespoon goji 10 g; 100 g evaporation, pandan removed. Source does not define carbohydrate convention; reported carbohydrate used without adding fibre. Generic sweet dessert may differ substantially from patient plain gum; not a pure-ingredient reference.

shark's fin.note: Dry reference diluted by explicitly assumed five-fold final water uptake. Species, soaking yield and cooking losses unknown; prepared ingredient estimate, not a measured cooked reference.

fish maw.note: Dry reference diluted by explicitly assumed five-fold final water uptake. Species, soaking yield and cooking losses unknown; prepared ingredient estimate, not a measured cooked reference.

source_notes: USDA FNDDS 2019-2020 and SR Legacy 2018 downloaded from FoodData Central. IDs are explicit selections, not automatic fuzzy matches.
CFS Chinese composition entries may report insoluble fibre; preserve fibre definition rather than assert equivalence to total dietary fibre.
CFS NIIS describes personal non-commercial/reference use. Retain attribution; do not treat its contents as USDA public-domain data.
Recipes with unspecified amounts use declared project assumptions. Source inspiration does not verify those assumed proportions.
assumptions: Per-100g edible portion. Unknown vegetable/fruit preparation uses raw reference per project instruction.
Cooked staple and animal-food defaults; finished products use product-as-consumed references.
Recipe proportions estimate unrecorded composition, not measured patient ingredients.
Reference means a food-composition estimate, never a measured patient meal.
Species proxies and generic product defaults remain labelled; no claim of exact patient nutrient values.
Recipe ingredient proportions and cooked/rehydrated yield must be recorded explicitly.
USDA total carbohydrate is the target basis. CFS available carbohydrate is converted by adding documented dietary fibre, with provenance.
CFC2002 fibre is insoluble fibre: retained as a labelled lower-bound proxy, not falsely described as measured total fibre.
No missing source nutrient is silently zero-filled; any substitution requires a separate declared reference or assumption.
